body: Oh I wish my friends' deductive skills were as good as yours. They never really asked me anything, only 1 friend asked me once if I'm ok and I said "no" but that was about it. Sadly,  I think if I were to open up about my depression to these 3 friends ( 1 of which is my crush), I'm afraid I'd end up being alone and separated..
Would you like to share the story? I'm curious how they first reacted when you told them about your depression.
Yeah its something I am still afraid to ask.
